title: Enrich Registry Metadata from Code
description: The flow for filling all 8 registry fields from GDScript source. Read code → extract identity → draft fields → edit JSON → validate.

nodes.label: Find registry entry
nodes.detail: Search commons/artifacts/registry/*.json for the lookup_name. Note which file and current field state.

nodes.label: Find and read the GDScript
nodes.detail: Follow the 'scene' field to the .tscn, find the .gd in the same directory. Read it fully.

nodes.label: Has @identity block?
nodes.detail: Look for # @identity in first 15 lines. If present, extract all 8 fields. If not, you'll draft one later.

nodes.label: Draft 5-layer description
nodes.detail: 1. Phenomenological (from @identity desire/essence) 2. Algorithmic (what principle) 3. Relational (prepares for/contrasts with) 4. QFEP-structural (where in E=F+λφdE) 5. Capacity (what learner can DO)

nodes.label: Draft QFEP connection
nodes.detail: Category mapping: primitives/transforms→F, randomness/noise→E(S), fractals/lsystems→λ, morphogenesis/swarm→φdE, forces/physics→Classical F, CA→Edge of chaos

nodes.label: Draft remaining fields
nodes.detail: gamwell_reference: from theoretical context. interactions: from @identity triggers/needs. capacity: VERB what_learner_can_do. tags: 5-10 keywords. signals: from 'signal' declarations in code.

nodes.label: Write update script (for batch) or use Edit (for single)
nodes.detail: For batch: Python script that reads JSON, updates fields, writes back. For single: Edit tool directly on the JSON file. Always json.dump with indent=tab and ensure_ascii=False.

nodes.label: Re-score to confirm improvement
nodes.detail: Run the per-field scoring. Should see 6-7/8 (signals often 0 for artifacts without GDScript signal declarations, footprint needs Godot capture).

summary: Find registry entry → read GDScript → extract @identity → draft 8 fields → edit JSON → validate → re-score.
